Name: TheGeodeInnAndeanRun
GameplayLoops: Run → slide → jump chasms → dodge obstacles → bank the opal at the base.
Title: The Geode Inn: Andean Run
Storyline: Race the terraces of a Peruvian mountain temple, leap the chasms, and carry the Andean Opal down before the path gives way behind.
Tagline: A Peruvian temple run, one chasm from the end.
ArtDirection: High-altitude dawn, terraced stone, woven color.

Name: TheGeodeInnBeadBoard
GameplayLoops: Listen → recall sequence → place stones → score → escalating length.
Title: The Geode Inn: Bead Board
Storyline: The Inn sings a chord of numbered stones, then hides their names. Echo it back — place the right stone in each slot across five rounds of growing length.
GeodeCharacters: The Inn's hearth; the stone choir
Tagline: The Inn sings a chord; echo it back in stone.

Name: TheGeodeInnElMukisMine
GameplayLoops: Dig → brace shafts → dodge the Muki → surface with ore.
Title: The Geode Inn: El Muki's Mine
Storyline: Dig deep beneath the Andes, but avoid the Muki's trap — the mountain spirit that collapses the shaft behind a greedy hand. Surface with the vein or stay below.
Tagline: Dig deep beneath the Andes; avoid the Muki's trap.
ArtDirection: Andean lantern, ore glow, rock dust.

Name: TheGeodeInnJigsawRelics
GameplayLoops: Sort pieces → place → clear mechanic → restore relic → archive it.
Title: The Geode Inn: Jigsaw Relics
Storyline: Reassemble ancient artifacts from the Spiral Gallery. Some pieces drift, some are buried, some are being watched — four engines, one catalog of relics.
Tagline: Reassemble ancient artifacts from the Spiral Gallery.
ArtDirection: Gallery dusk, gilded frame, scattered shards.

Name: TheGeodeInnKappasCrossing
GameplayLoops: Hop → ride logs → dodge the Kappa → reach the far bank.
Title: The Geode Inn: Kappa's Crossing
Storyline: Cross the river without the Kappa's grasp. Time the logs, the lily pads, and the turtle backs — the Kappa waits in the water for a single slip.
Tagline: Cross the river without the Kappa's grasp.
ArtDirection: River dusk, lily green, lantern current.

Name: TheGeodeInnLabyrinth
GameplayLoops: Explore → lay thread → avoid the Minotaur → reach center → escape.
Title: The Geode Inn: Labyrinth
Storyline: Navigate the Minotaur's maze beneath Knossos. Unwind the thread, mark the turns, and reach the heart before the horned shadow finds you in the dark.
Tagline: Navigate the Minotaur's maze beneath Knossos.
ArtDirection: Bronze-age dark, torch gutter, stone horn shadow.

Name: TheGeodeInnMonsterOfTheDeep
GameplayLoops: Dive → dodge → descend layers → pearl retrieval → surface.
Title: The Geode Inn: Monster of the Deep
Storyline: Run the sea floor, leap the crawlers, hold steady under the jellies, and descend to the glowing cave to claim the Freshwater Pearl from the serpent's watch.
GeodeCharacters: The Deep Ones; the freshwater serpent
Tagline: A Loch Ness hunt, down to the glowing cave.
ArtDirection: Böcklin green, bioluminescent cave, kelp silhouette.

Name: TheGeodeInnNidhoggsDescent
GameplayLoops: Slither → gnaw → grow → avoid self → descend levels.
Title: The Geode Inn: Nidhogg's Descent
Storyline: Descend the roots of the World Tree as the serpent Nidhogg — gnaw the root-lines, grow long, and don't bite your own coil as you fall toward the deep.
Tagline: Descend the roots of the World Tree as the serpent.

Name: TheGeodeInnRuneSweeper
GameplayLoops: Reveal tile → read rune count → flag → excavate → clear chamber.
Title: The Geode Inn: Rune Sweeper
Storyline: Beneath the Inn lie chambers seeded with sleeping runestones. Read the carved numbers, light candles where you suspect a stone, and excavate every safe tile.
GeodeCharacters: The Catacombs keeper; the sleeping runestones
Tagline: Beneath the Inn lie sleeping runestones.

Name: TheGeodeInnSphinxsRiddle
GameplayLoops: Hear riddle → weigh answers → commit → advance or reset.
Title: The Geode Inn: Sphinx's Riddle
Storyline: Outwit the Sphinx beneath the Egyptian sun. Each round, a riddle of stone and star; answer in the allotted breaths or be turned back at the gate.
Tagline: Outwit the Sphinx beneath the Egyptian sun.
ArtDirection: Noon desert, limestone gate, gold dust.

Name: TheGeodeInnStandingStones
GameplayLoops: Falling stones → rotate and drop → clear rows → race the dawn timer; each clear tunes the circle one note higher.
Title: The Geode Inn: Standing Stones
Storyline: Before dawn, stack the Preseli Blue monoliths into clean rows to ring the Fae Kingdom's stone-circle portal open.
GeodeCharacters: The Tunnel Keeper; the Fae stone-circle
Tagline: Stack the standing stones before the dawn breaks.
ArtDirection: Neolithic dusk-light, candle-lit slab, carved runic grid.

Name: TheGeodeInnStoneDominance
GameplayLoops: Place → flank → flip lines → board majority → win.
Title: The Geode Inn: Stone Dominance
Storyline: Amber and Obsidian on a carved slab. Trap the rival's line between your stones and watch it flip — face the Inn's keepers or pass-and-play.
Tagline: Amber and Obsidian on a carved slab.
ArtDirection: Carved slate, two-tone stone, candle tension.

Name: TheGeodeInnStoneMemory
GameplayLoops: Flip → match pairs → ring chord → clear chamber → next property.
Title: The Geode Inn: Stone Memory
Storyline: The ancient memory game, carved into a temple floor. Flip stones two at a time; matched pairs ring a chord. Each chamber matches by a different mineral property.
GeodeCharacters: The Archive monks; the mineral choir
Tagline: The ancient memory game, carved into a temple floor.
ArtDirection: Temple flagstone, candle ring, mineral glow.

Name: TheGeodeInnStoneSolitaire
GameplayLoops: Draw → stack suits → clear board → collect a drawn card.
Title: The Geode Inn: Stone Solitaire
Storyline: Klondike with the Royo deck. Build the four foundations — Hearth, Depths, Wild, Earth — to draw a card for the collection.
ArtDirection: Hearthside felt, gold-leaf card backs, gem pips.

Name: TheGeodeInnTheCaravan
GameplayLoops: Plan route → manage endurance → trade → survive → reach platform.
Title: The Geode Inn: The Caravan
Storyline: Trade stones across the Inn's ley lines. Manage endurance, raise charms for protection, tune the attunement to charge faster, and reach each cultural platform alive.
GeodeCharacters: The Caravan; the Silk Road platforms
Tagline: Trade stones across the Inn's ley lines.
ArtDirection: Caravan dusk, silk color, ley-line glow.

Name: TheGeodeInnTheFaerieQuest
GameplayLoops: Explore → quest → build reputation → gather stones → resolve the court.
Title: The Geode Inn: The Faerie Quest
Storyline: Quest through the Fae Kingdom. Earn reputation with the Seelie and Unseelie courts, gather the court stones, and stand between the two thrones before the bargain comes due.
GeodeCharacters: The Fae Kingdom; the Seelie and Unseelie courts
Tagline: Quest through the Fae Kingdom between two thrones.
ArtDirection: Fae light, court gold, thorn and silk.

Name: TheGeodeInnTheInBetween
GameplayLoops: Tune mirror → phase → traverse → solve room → descend.
Title: The Geode Inn: The In-Between
Storyline: Navigate the shadow frequency. The In-Between bends light and sound — tune the octave mirror to phase through walls and walk the negative space between the Inn's rooms.
GeodeCharacters: The Shadow Inn; the octave mirror
Tagline: Navigate the shadow frequency between the Inn's rooms.
ArtDirection: Negative-space black, mirror silver, breath fog.

Name: TheGeodeInnTombTunnel
GameplayLoops: Dig → pump sand → collapse monsters → descend chambers → recover the heart.
Title: The Geode Inn: Tomb Tunnel
Storyline: Burrow through the Egyptian dark, pump the sand, and surface the tomb's beating heart to claim the Lapis Lazuli before the scarabs swarm.
GeodeCharacters: The Hearth Tender; the scarab swarm
Tagline: Dig Dug in the Egyptian dark.
ArtDirection: Lantern-lit sand, funerary gold, scarab shadow.

Name: TheGeodeInnTumbleRun
GameplayLoops: Roll → jump → duck → reach node → survive the course.
Title: The Geode Inn: Tumble Run
Storyline: Help Tumble not get stuck. The four-inch furball rolls toward every resonance node — jump, duck, and keep it from going home while the Brownies cheer from the rafters.
GeodeCharacters: Tumble the four-inch furball; the Brownies Franjean & Rool
ArtDirection: Rafters and candlelight, brownie mischief, furball physics.
